summary: A mixed legal and retail day, anchored by a Supreme Court trademark jurisdiction referral and a Delhi HC ruling on EU sanctions override. Retail sector sees gold sales drop 15% and mobile retailers seek UPI charge exemptions.

bullets.text: Supreme Court refers to larger bench whether civil courts can hear trademark suits, signaling jurisdictional uncertainty.
Delhi HC orders SAP to restore software services to Nayara Energy, ruling EU sanctions cannot override commercial contracts.
Gold sales volume fell 15% during Ganesh Chaturthi this year versus prior year amid elevated prices.
All India Mobile Retailers Association requests Finance Ministry exemption from proposed UPI transaction charges for small retailers.
Google agrees to report child sexual abuse material directly to Indian authorities, bypassing U.S. reporting protocols.
